privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: How we handle the information you share with us.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: {{company}} (“IP3”, “we”) operates this website. You can reach us at {{email}} or {{address}}.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: When you use the contact form we receive the name, email address, organization and message you choose to share. This website does not require an account.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: To prepare a proposal or discuss a collaboration you have asked about.
To meet legal or contractual obligations.

sections.heading: Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with service providers who help us run our email and website, and where the law requires.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: This site sets no advertising cookies. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which may receive your IP address as part of delivering them.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You may ask us to access, correct or delete the personal data we hold about you by writing to {{email}}.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The date below shows when it last changed.
This text is a plain-language summary and should be reviewed by IP3’s legal counsel before launch.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.lead: The terms that apply when you use this website.

sections.heading: Use of this website
paragraphs: This website is provided for general information about {{company}}. By using it you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Content, logos and design on this website belong to {{company}} or its licensors. You may share links and short quotations with attribution; other reproduction needs our written permission.

sections.heading: No professional advice
paragraphs: Content is general and does not constitute legal, financial or investment advice. Engagements are governed by the terms agreed in writing with each client.

sections.heading: Third-party links
paragraphs: We are not responsible for the content or practices of third-party sites linked from this website.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: We take care to keep information accurate and current but provide it without warranty to the fullest extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of Bangladesh.
